description: NOT CBOM ecosystem coverage -- see BLOCKERS.md. Real crypto detection requires `--profile research` and runs via atom-based reachable slicing in the evinser pass AFTER createBom returns (bin/cdxgen.js:1681); the golden runner calls createBom directly and structurally cannot reach it. What this scenario actually covers: `collectSourceCryptoComponents` reached through createMultiXBom via a synthetic ["js","mcp"] projectType (the multi-type route is the only one that enters that loop). Its value is narrow and purely normalizer-facing -- it is the only golden containing `cryptographic-asset` components, which carry NO purl and use OID-derived bom-refs, so it guards bom-ref derivation for purl-less components. Do not cite it as evidence that crypto detection works.
